title: Level 2 (Communicative), batch 4: Flirting, Airport, Sightseeing, Bar, Numbers & time
source_note: English from docs/LEVEL_CUT.md Part B. Changes: 'Do you have change for ___?' became 'Do you have change for this?' with the reply 'Sorry, I don't have change.'; 'Is that ___ AM or PM?' became 'In the morning or in the evening?'; 'Are all the floors accessible?' became 'Is it wheelchair accessible?'; two follow-ups reuse existing phrases ('How much extra?', 'How much is this?').
concepts: Would you like to do something this weekend?
What's the best way to reach you?
Only if you're comfortable with that.
I'd rather stay with my friends.
Do I need to go through security again?
How can I track my bag?
Do you need my hotel address?
Can I get a reference number?
I can show you my return ticket.
Do I need to book ahead?
Is there an audio guide in English?
Could you call me a taxi?
I need a safe way home.
How much is it including tax?
In the morning or in the evening?
Do you have change for this?
replies: The upper floor has stairs only.
It'll be here in ten minutes.
It starts at seven in the evening.

*.l2_give_space: PRIORITY REVIEW (a boundary that must stay firm).
*.l2_stay_with_friends: PRIORITY REVIEW (a boundary: a clear, polite no).
*.l2_next_week: Only after a 'busy' answer. If the answer was a no, say 'No worries, another time.' instead.
*.l2_here_tourism: Border questions: say only what is true for your trip.

pt-PT.l2_best_way_reach: o to a man, a to a woman.

es.l2_check_bag: Spain. Latin America: "¿Puedo documentar esta maleta?"
es.l2_seven_evening: Seven is "de la tarde" in Spain, "de la noche" in much of Latin America.

ru.l2_busy_weekend: занята said by a woman, занят by a man.
ru.l2_only_need_tickets: два/три/четыре билета; with five or more the noun changes (билетов).

ja.l2_give_space: PRIORITY REVIEW (a boundary that must stay firm). Literally 'Please keep a little distance.' Reviewer: is this firm enough?
ja.l2_only_if_comfortable: Literally 'only if it suits you': the natural way to take pressure off.

he.l2_busy_weekend: Said by a woman. A man: עסוק (a-SOOK).
he.l2_give_space: PRIORITY REVIEW (a boundary that must stay firm). To a woman: תני לי (tnee lee).

ar-levantine.l2_busy_weekend: Said by a woman. A man: مشغول (mash-GHOOL).
ar-levantine.l2_give_space: PRIORITY REVIEW (a boundary that must stay firm). To a woman: اتركيلي.
ar-levantine.l2_live_music: Bars and alcohol are not a given everywhere; this set is for places that have them.
